verses.1: Thus said the LORD to His Messiah: “I have strengthened him in my hand to go before me. Nations will submit to him, and kings will open their doors and gates for him, so that they cannot be closed.”
verses.2: I am before you. I will go and seal the doors shut. I will also use iron bars to secure them.
verses.3: And I will give you hidden treasures and secrets, so that you may know that I am Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.4: So that my servant Jacob and Israel may be saved by my choice. I will call to you by your name, and you will not know me.
verses.5: I am Jehovah. There is no other god besides Me. I will protect you, and you will never know Me.
verses.6: So that they may know from the east and from the west that I, Jehovah, am alone, and there is no other god besides me.
verses.7: I create light and darkness; I bring about peace or harm. I am Jehovah, who does all these things.
verses.8: Let the heavens pour down from above, and let justice be established. Let the earth be opened up, and let salvation and righteousness grow together. I, Jehovah, will create them.
verses.9: Oh, increase your creation! Destroy the crops of the land. He said, “What shall I do with my creation? My hands are unable to do anything.”
verses.10: “Oh, say to the father, ‘What will he give birth to?’ And to the woman, ‘What will she begin to do?’”
verses.11: As Jehovah the Holy One of Israel has said: “These creatures have questioned me about my children and about the works of my hands.”
verses.12: I created the earth, and I created man upon it. I set my hands over the heavens, and I commanded all their creatures.
verses.13: I will build it in righteousness, and all its paths will be established. He will build my city, and my exile will not be sent away at a price or by means of deceit. As the Lord, the Almighty, said.
verses.14: Thus said Yahweh: “The people of Egypt will come and carry away Cush and Seba. They will pass by you, but they will not stay with you. They will go ahead of you, but they will not worship you or pray to you. But in you alone is the true God.”
verses.15: Now, you are the one who reveals the secrets of the God of Israel. You are the savior.
verses.16: Boshu and Gammelmu also went together. They walked together along the path of the trees.
verses.17: Israel shall be saved by the LORD; it shall not be smitten or destroyed, forever and ever.
verses.18: For as Jehovah said, “In creating the heavens, He is the God who created the earth. He is the one who shapes it; no one else can do this. I am Jehovah, and there is no other.”
verses.19: I did not speak in a secret place, in a dark land. I did not say to Jacob’s descendants, “Come to me; I am Jehovah, the God of truth. I will speak truthfully.”
verses.20: They were brought together and became one. The refugees from other nations did not know how to cultivate their crops. They prayed to God, but He did not save them.
verses.21: Speak and declare it, and let them also speak together. Who else could speak this from the beginning? I am Jehovah, and there is no other God besides me. I am the righteous and the savior of my people.
verses.22: Turn to me, and be saved from all the troubles of the earth. For I am the Lord, and there is no other god besides me.
verses.23: I will praise you; righteousness will come from my lips. It will not return to me, for I will humble myself before you. All blessings will be praised by me, and all joys will be shared with me.
verses.24: But in Jehovah, I said that righteousness and strength will come to me. And all the enemies will be defeated by him.
verses.25: In the LORD, they will be righteous and praise Him; all the descendants of Israel will do so.
